prs.title: Only run the CORP check on HTTP(S) navigation responses
prs.author: shannonbooth
prs.body:
Under COEP, the check previously blocked about:blank, data:, and blob:
responses in a child navigable. They have no CORP header, so it treated
them as same-origin, which an opaque origin never matches, nor does a
blob: URL created by a cross-origin child. Chromium, Gecko, and WebKit
allow about:blank and data:; Chromium and Gecko also allow blob:.

Tests:
 * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/html/cross-origin-embedder-policy/non-initial-about-blank.https.html
 * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/html/cross-origin-embedder-policy/data.https.html
 * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64047

Fixes #13086.

- [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed):
   * Chromium (implements)
   * Firefox (implements)
   * Webkit (implements, beside from blob URL case)
- [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at:
   * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/html/cross-origin-embedder-policy/non-initial-about-blank.https.html
   * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/html/cross-origin-embedder-policy/data.https.html
   * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64047
- [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed:
   * Chromium: n/a
   * Gecko: n/a
   * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=328493
   * Deno (only for timers, structured clone
